High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the applicants contends that vide order dated 14.11.2018 passed in W.P.No.8510/2013 (Annexure C/3), this Court directed the respondent Nos.1 to 4 therein to determine the compensation in terms of the provisions of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 within a period of six months from the date of submission of certified copy of this order and in the second part of the order, this Court observed that if such exercise is not completed within the aforesaid period, the petitioner herein would be entitled for interest at the rate of 9% over the amount of compensation.
It is contended by the counsel for the petitioner that the compensation has been paid to the petitioner on 22.07.2021 (Annexure R/1), admittedly after lapse of six months from the date of order i.e. 14.11.2018 (Annexure C/3)

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: , therefore, the respondents were duty bound to pay the interest as well as in terms of the order passed by this Court.
Shri Sanjeev Kumar Singh, Panel Lawyer for the respondent/State prays for time to file additional compliance report.
Office is directed to reflect the name of Shri Sanjeev Kumar Singh, Advocate for the respondent/State.

If the additional compliance report is not filed by the next date of hearing, respondent No.4 i.e.
Collector Sehore shall remain personally present before this Court.
